description: Last real conclusion of every job in every push/pull_request workflow. The object list is discovered by parsing .github/workflows, not enumerated here, because the enforcement surface ledger only classifies scripts/qa/* and would never have looked at boundary-coverage, test, clippy, miri or cross-compile. Verified offline by scripts/qa/ci-liveness.rb in the ci.yml governance job; refreshed from `gh run` locally with --refresh --write.

knownFailing.reason: Only the liveness step failed in run 30201994098. All 22 other gates in the job reported success, including persistence-extraction on its first CI execution, and every other job in the run was green. The cause is the same shape twice over: this ledger recorded run 30191178845 at c0730b78, and 4462587f then added the persistence-extraction step to ci.yml, so the record described a pipeline that no longer existed. The previous round had the same failure from b85eef73's persistence-dependency step. This is the two-step convergence DD-146 records — the job cannot record its own recovery in one pass, because its liveness step runs inside itself. This refresh makes the record current against a run at 0c9b7a54, which is after that ci.yml change; the next run should show governance green and the following refresh drops this annotation.

workflows.reason: triggered by v* tags and workflow_dispatch only, so it has no last-run-on-main to assert. A release that fails is visible at the moment someone cuts it, and recording a stale tag build here would say less than nothing.
